claim: Setting scratch flag $00 switches the player to the alternate idle animations ($10-$13) with every form; the pose it shows is the open question (purpose UNKNOWN).

trial.control: warp to scene $06 with $00 clear; record playerActor animation index and a screenshot of the idle pose
trial.forced: repeat with $00 set (gaia.flags write on $0A00 bit 0) for Will, then Freedan and Shadow (form via $0AD4)
observe: ladder idle and shimmy detach for the same flag value

confirms: effects.set of sys_player_alt_idle_active (anims $10-$13 for every form)
refutes: any form that keeps anim $00-$03 with the flag set (the branch would not be form-independent)

claim: Scenes where scene_flag_init is placed (26) start every visit in the alternate idle; compare Itory ($15) arrival with the flag forced clear.

trial.control: warp to scene $15 normally and observe the idle pose after 2 frames
trial.forced: clear $00 each frame (write $0A00 &= ~1) and observe

confirms: scene_flag_init sets $00 on its first tick and the alternate idle is visible
refutes: no difference between the two runs

claim: palette_parent_child never spawns its child wave: nothing sets scratch $01 in scenes $FD and $FF.

claim: World thinkers parked on WaitOnFlagByte($FF clear) (flag_gated_palette_cool/warm, gold_ship_wreck_palette) either replay their bundle after an inventory open/close or stay parked.

trial.forced: open and close the inventory, record CGRAM again and the thinker slot state

confirms: whether the thinker wakes on the clear and replays bundle #4C

claim: Boot logo latch: $10 is clear when scene $FB starts, set during the first logo and cleared before the title; no save value leaks in.

trial.control: cold boot with a populated SRAM and watch $0A02 bit 0 through the two logos and the title
trial.forced: soft reset in the middle of the game with $10 set and watch the logos

confirms: two-visit latch with no leak
refutes: the second logo skipped or repeated
